notes.title: WonderLang Update – Major Japanese Version Improvements!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work making WonderLang even better for Japanese learners, and we’re excited to share what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Voice & Text Improvements[/h3][p]Even though our original voiceovers were created by a native Japanese speaker, some players noticed mispronunciations in certain lines. To make sure everything sounds natural, we brought in a second native freelancer to carefully check [i]every single dialogue line[/i].[/p][p]As a result, we’ve:[/p][list][*][p]Replaced [b]56 dialogue lines[/b] with corrected pronunciation.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified some early-game text to make it more beginner-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted pacing in a few places so the audio feels smoother and easier to follow.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]2. New Keyboard Options[/h3][p]Japanese learners use very different input methods depending on their background, so we’ve added new keyboard layouts to make typing easier for everyone:[/p][list][*][p][b]Grouped Kana Keyboard[/b] - For beginners who struggled with the standard JIS layout, this version groups kana by sound, making it easier to find characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IME Kana Keyboard[/b] - Type in romaji, and the keyboard automatically converts your input into kana.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IME Kanji Keyboard[/b] (Kanji mode only) - Start with romaji, which converts to kana, and then press the space bar to turn kana into kanji directly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Different players have different play styles, so whether you’re a total beginner or already used to typing in Japanese, WonderLang now adapts to [i]you[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Bug Fixes[/h3][p]We’ve also squashed a lot of bugs over the past few weeks. If you ever encounter an issue, please let us know at [/p][p][url="https://contact@wonderlang.net"]contact@wonderlang.net[/url] [/p][p]most reports are solved within 24 hours.[/p][p][/p][h3]4. What’s Next[/h3][p]We’re now working on a [b]complete redesign of the UI and menus[/b]. In September, you’ll see:[/p][list][*][p]Cleaner, more responsive menus.[/p][/*][*][p]More customization options for both the game and menu appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]A greatly improved notepad.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]toggle to switch between base and target language[/b] in all menus.[/p][/*][/list][p]This overhaul also prepares WonderLang for the arrival of new base languages (currently only English). WonderLang is not just for anglophones; expect new base languages [i]before the end of the year[/i]![/p][hr][/hr][p]✨ Thank you for playing and supporting WonderLang. We’re committed to making the game as fun, accessible, and adaptable as possible.[/p]

notes.title: Update August 21st 2025
notes.content:
- Added a IME-keyboard to type kanji characters (first version, please send feedback at contact@wonderlang.net)
- Added a new noraml keyboard layout where characters are grouped by sound.
- Corrected some missing translation.

notes.title: Hot Fix July 13th 2025
notes.content:
- Corrected wrong translation for "I understand"
- Corrected Furigana display issue

notes.title: Hot Fix July 8th 2025
notes.content:
- Corrected a wrong pronounciation from Haruto-kun at the start of the game.
- Corrected an issue that blocked the player during mouse mouvements.

notes.title: Update: July 31st 2025
notes.content:
- Added a bug reporting tool
- Add an option to customize combat length/difficulty
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash in the Postman's house while talking to the kid upstairs.

notes.title: Update July 23rd 2025
notes.content:
- Added Furigana options: Display furigana (pronounciation kana) above new or all kanji words
- Added an additional mini-game to learn Hirgana
- Correct several cases of missing translations
